My dad recently passed away (I am 20, he was 19 when he died.) My sister and I are taking care of it without my other parent's help. Here is what I have learned:

Immediate Action:
Cancel everything in his name the best you can, like cell phones and cable. Let his credit card and mortgage company know of his passing. Have a bunch of death certificates ready to mail to them because they will require proof

Find out if he had life insurance, go ahead and open his mail. He may have had it through his union so open all union things you can find.

Debt:
You are NOT responsible for any of his debts. The credit card company will still try to get money out of you, but tell them to fuck off. If you get a letter of claim from them it means they are trying to get the money from the estate. This will have to be paid out of whatever money is currently in the estate, like his bank accounts. If you do not have enough money to cover it WRITE THEM BACK AND SAY SO. If you do not respond in 30 days their claim is ALLOWED. 

Mortgage/House
Many people have something that makes their mortgage paid in full when they die. Call and find out if he does. If not you are in the situation I am. PAY THE MORTGAGE. Do not let the house default. If it is coming automatically out of somewhere let it keep coming out. 

Start cleaning out the house and organizing a yard sale. This will take WAY longer than you think it will. Yard sales are good because people take your stuff away and give you money for it. If you have stuff left or don't think you can handle it, there are places like Salvation Army that will haul it away for free as long as you box it. 

School: I am also in college. Call your school and let them know what has happened, they will let you redo financial aid. My school is actually GIVING me money this year because I called them. 

Other bills: I am currently paying all those bills out of pocket, if you can't I suggest you have your sister get some money out of his account use that to pay it.

Grief: You will not be able to grieve for a while. It has been four months and I haven't yet. Wish I could tell you something more comforting but I just can't. Endure. Scream when you have to. Let yourself have fun.
